curtain is to stage - part/whole, performance field
juror is to courtroom - worker/location, legal field, wrong internal relation

explanation: An emergency measure and the spreading harm it is imposed to stop: a curfew is clamped on to halt disorder, as a tourniquet is clamped on to halt bleeding. dune is to desert - part/whole, landform field
summit is to peak - near-synonyms, no scale difference at all

explanation: Product to maker, and the product is specifically the professional pronouncement the practitioner is qualified to deliver: a sermon is the preacher's, as a diagnosis is the physician's. explanation: Provisional version to finished work: a draft is the trial version that precedes a statute, as a sketch is the trial version that precedes a mural. distractor_rationales: treaty is to peace - instrument/outcome, legal field
diplomat is to accord - worker/product, legal field
clause is to charter - part/whole, legal field, tempting to anyone matching topic

explanation: All five choices are a part paired with the whole it belongs to, so part/whole alone settles nothing. The stem's relation is narrower: the keystone is the one part that locks the arch together and without which it falls. The spine is what holds a book's pages together; remove the mural, the gargoyle, the pew or the cover and the whole still stands.
distractor_rationales: mural is to wall - part/whole, but decorative rather than load-bearing
gargoyle is to facade - part/whole in the stem's architectural field, ornamental only
pew is to cathedral - part/whole, architectural field, furnishing rather than structure
cover is to magazine - part/whole in the key's publishing field, protective but not what holds the whole together

explanation: Outcome named first, then the excess of behaviour that brought it on: bankruptcy is what extravagance ends in, as fatigue is what exertion ends in. Two distractors run a cause-to-effect pair in the expected order (thrift/savings, poverty/hardship) and two more sit in the stem's financial field, so the item turns on reading the direction.
distractor_rationales: thrift is to savings - correct relation reversed, cause before effect, financial field
creditor is to loan - agent/instrument, financial field
sweat is to athlete - effect and the person, not effect and cause, in the key's physical field
poverty is to hardship - cause before effect, and closer to condition and consequence than to excess and ruin

explanation: A device paired with the specific act it is fitted to prevent: a muzzle is fitted to prevent a bite, as a lid is fitted to prevent a spill. Bridle/horse is the sharpest trap - a restraint, in the stem's animal field, but paired with the creature restrained rather than with the act prevented. Cork/bottle keeps the key's household field occupied.
distractor_rationales: collar is to dog - object/animal, planted in the stem's animal field
bridle is to horse - right family of device, wrong second term: the creature, not the act prevented
cork is to bottle - part/whole in the key's container field, not device and act prevented
kennel is to hound - location/occupant, animal field

explanation: Worker to finished product: a weaver makes a tapestry as a potter makes an urn. The distractors offer the neighbouring relations a candidate must rule out - worker to raw material, worker to tool, and worker to location.
distractor_rationales: loom is to thread - tool/material, not maker and product
sculptor is to marble - worker/raw material, a related but different relation
tailor is to needle - worker/tool, a related but different relation
critic is to gallery - worker/location

explanation: Member to category: an emerald is one kind of gem as a trombone is one kind of instrument. Four distractors keep the candidate inside the stem's jewellery field with other relations entirely.
distractor_rationales: jeweler is to sapphire - worker/material, topical associate of the stem
gem is to necklace - part/whole, topical associate
sapphire is to blue - thing/characteristic, jewellery field
mine is to ore - location/contents

explanation: A room built for the storing of one class of thing, paired with what it stores: provisions in a pantry, weapons in an armory. Harvest/granary is the same storage relation with the terms exchanged.
distractor_rationales: cook is to pantry - worker/location, topical associate
cellar is to damp - place/characteristic, not place and contents
shelf is to jar - support and the object on it, a related but different relation
harvest is to granary - correct relation reversed, contents before the storeroom

explanation: Antonyms: to tighten is the exact reverse of to loosen, as to kindle is the exact reverse of to extinguish. The distractors are a synonym pair, a degree pair, a tool pair and a part pair, so the option list holds four different structures rather than four obvious rejects.
distractor_rationales: fasten is to secure - synonyms, in the stem's field of fastening
wrench is to bolt - tool/object, topical associate of the stem
smolder is to blaze - degree of intensity, in the key's field of fire
knot is to rope - part/whole

explanation: An animal and the trait it is proverbially taken to embody: the fox stands for cunning as the mule stands for stubbornness. No other choice pairs a creature with a quality - serpent/venom is a possession, not a trait.
distractor_rationales: hound is to kennel - occupant/location, animal field
cub is to bear - young/adult, animal field
serpent is to venom - creature and a physical possession, not a character trait
shepherd is to flock - worker and what he tends

explanation: Equipment to the craftsman who works at it, tool named first: a kiln belongs to a potter as an anvil belongs to a smith. Two other choices also begin with a tool, but pair it with a material or an activity instead of with the worker.
distractor_rationales: baker is to dough - worker/material, the reverse order and the wrong second term
chisel is to marble - tool/material, not tool and worker
printer is to pamphlet - worker/product
loom is to weaving - tool and the activity performed with it, a related but different relation

explanation: Synonyms: to abridge is to shorten, as to pledge is to promise. The distractors are an action-and-object pair, an antonym pair, a second action-and-object pair and a condensation-of pair, so nothing else restates its first term.
distractor_rationales: cancel is to event - action/object, not a restatement
hasten is to linger - antonyms, the opposite structure
revise is to manuscript - action/object, in the stem's editorial field
summary is to report - condensed version and the whole, the stem's field but not a synonym pair
